subject: Request: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 for Helix Therapeutics
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cole <dana@helixtx.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 request

Dana —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation your procurement team asked for a temporary invoice cadence that lines up with your fiscal quarters while we finalize the enterprise onboarding timeline. I put together a short proposal attached (Helix_Billing_Plan.xlsx) that lays out a transitional quarterly invoicing option plus a conditional Net-90 payment term for the first two quarters while Helix ramps usage.

High level:
- Quarter 1 invoice (covers initial onboarding & 3 weeks of production) due Net-30.
- Quarters 2–3 invoiced quarterly, payment Net-90, conditional on: 1) signed SOW, 2) usage not exceeding agreed cap, and 3) a 30% upfront first-quarter invoice applied as credit against Q2.

Can you confirm whether Procurements can accept that structure as a short-term bridge (we expect to revert to standard monthly Net-30 after Q3)? If you prefer, we can propose a refundable escrow or a simple early-pay discount to mitigate finance concerns.

Attachments: Helix_Billing_Plan.xlsx (billing cadence + sample invoice), Helix_SOW_v3.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Dana Cole <dana@helixtx.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@helixtx.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 12:03:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 request

Camila —

Appreciate the thoughtful proposal. Our treasury group is pushing for Net-90 on quarterly invoices for enterprise agreements because of internal cashflow timing. They also asked whether Helix could have a single quarterly invoice per legal entity instead of monthly line items.

Two quick asks from procurement:
1) Can Redwood accept Net-90 for the next two quarters (Q2 & Q3) as a temporary accommodation?
2) Can you confirm what safeguards Redwood wants (usage caps, early-pay discount, escrow, or prepay) so our finance folks can sign off?

I've attached our standard procurement_form.pdf — it captures internal reqs. If you can get this escalated to your finance/ops and share recommended guardrails we can move the contract through our pipeline.

Best,
Dana Cole
Head of Procurement, Helix Therapeutics
dana@helixtx.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:20:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 request

Team —

Helix (large strategic prospect) is requesting a temporary Net-90 cadence on quarterly invoices for Q2 and Q3. They want to consolidate to one quarterly invoice per legal entity. Procurement attached their form (procurement_form.pdf).

My ask: can we approve a conditional Net-90 pilot for two quarters if we put in these guardrails?
- 30% upfront invoice at kickoff (applied as credit to Q2) OR refundable escrow (finance preference)
- Usage cap for the pilot quarter (we set soft and hard caps with overage rates)
- Standard SOW signed and explicit rollback to monthly Net-30 after Q3 unless both sides agree to extend
- Early-pay incentive: 2% discount for payments within 15 days

I've attached the draft SOW and billing plan we shared (Helix_SOW_v3.pdf, Helix_Billing_Plan.xlsx).

If Finance/Legal are comfortable, I want to respond to Dana today with a conditional agreement and DocuSign link.

Thanks — Camila
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:05:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 request

Camila —

Finance reviewed the ask. We can accept a timeboxed conditional Net-90 on quarterly invoices for Q2&Q3 provided the following minimum controls are in place:
1) 30% upfront invoice at kickoff as non-refundable credit against Q2 OR an on-account refundable escrow (preferred if procurement pushes back)
2) Maximum committed usage for the pilot quarter, with detailed overage pricing in the SOW (we should add a hard cap and automated throttling trigger)
3) Clause that reverts to standard monthly Net-30 billing after Q3 unless both parties sign an extension
4) A modest early-pay discount (1.5% within 14 days) rather than 2% to protect margin
5) Reserved right to pause service if invoicing falls more than 45 days overdue past Net-90 (material breach)

I'll flag a few accounting implications (revenue recognition, AR aging) in finance_risk_notes.txt and run a quick credit check on Helix. Legal should confirm the rollback language and the pause-right clause. If Legal OKs the language and Sales accepts the 1.5% early-pay discount, Finance can greenlight the pilot.

Jonas Weber
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dana Cole <dana@helixtx.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Transitional invoice bridge + conditional Net-90 request

Thanks all —

I reviewed Finance's notes and Legal's suggested rollback language. Given Helix's strategic fit and expected ARR, I approve a two-quarter conditional Net-90 pilot under the controls Jonas outlined: 30% kickoff invoice (applied as credit), 1.5% early-pay discount, hard usage cap with overage rates, rollback to Net-30 after Q3, and a pause-right for material delinquencies.

Camila — please send the revised SOW and billing schedule to Dana with the DocuSign link and note the pilot is timeboxed to Q2/Q3. CC me once sent.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
